title: Replica recall divergence
summary: A distributed vector database built from scratch (Raft, HNSW, gRPC replication, consistent hashing). It is a testbed for silent search-quality loss in replicated approximate indexes. Chaos tests on SIFT1M over 5 seeds show that node failures cause lasting recall divergence between replicas (p = 0.0079), while healthy replicas agree to 1e-4.

title: Null scaffold audit
summary: A pre-registered equivalence-testing audit (TOST, BCa bootstrap, Holm correction). It decides before publication whether a scaffolded NAS pipeline beats budget-matched restarts of its own bare searcher. Its 165-test suite at 98.23% coverage caught a fixed-seed bug in an in-house pipeline.
